# Vendored browser libraries

- Marked `15.0.12` — Markdown parser (MIT)
- DOMPurify `3.2.6` — HTML sanitizer (MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0)
- highlight.js `11.11.1` — code highlighting and GitHub Dark style (BSD-3-Clause)

These files are stored locally so the documentation renderer does not depend on a third-party CDN at runtime.
